description: Lookup exceptions: corrections to the generator's *_id -> <resource>_output lookups for this provider version. lookups is keyed by resource type ("*" = every resource), then argument. An entry states only what differs and inherits the "*" entry, which inherits the default (suffix-matched resource, read id, matched by name). Fields: resource, attribute (read instead of id), format (one %s, e.g. /subscriptions/%s), by ("name" or "key"), lookup (false = plain input), path (nested block, e.g. custom_parameters; only when the entry is limited to that block), note. Merged: this file -> settings repo copy -> manifest Module.resource_mapping.

group_id.note: Example (benign): restates the generator's default match, so output is unchanged. Copy this shape for a real exception.
